Factions.Name: Ming Imperial Court
Factions.Description: The Hongwu Emperor and the restored Han Chinese rule after the Mongol Yuan dynasty.

Technologies.Name: Treasure Fleet Expeditions
Technologies.History: Admiral Zheng He led seven massive naval expeditions across the Indian Ocean, displaying Ming naval supremacy.
Technologies.Description: Docks and Warships cost -15% resources. Warships gain +2 line of sight.

Technologies.Name: Shenjiying Firearm Corps
Technologies.History: The Ming established specialized firearm units using advanced gunpowder weapons including cannons, rockets, and handguns.
Technologies.Description: Gunpowder units gain +15% attack and +10% accuracy.

Heroes.Name: Zhu Yuanzhang
Heroes.History: Founder of the Ming dynasty, rose from peasant to emperor and overthrew Mongol rule.

Heroes.Name: Zheng He
Heroes.History: Muslim eunuch admiral who commanded the Ming treasure fleets across the Indian Ocean.

Heroes.Name: Qi Jiguang
Heroes.History: Famous general who defeated wokou pirates and reformed the Ming army with innovative tactics.

CivBonuses.Name: Grand Canal
CivBonuses.History: The Grand Canal connected northern and southern China, enabling efficient grain transport and trade.
CivBonuses.Description: Trade routes generate +20% income. Economic technologies research 20% faster.

CivBonuses.Name: Gunpowder Mastery
CivBonuses.History: China invented gunpowder and perfected its use in cannons, rockets, and early firearms.
CivBonuses.Description: Siege weapons and gunpowder units deal +10% splash damage.

TeamBonuses.Name: Silk Road Connections
TeamBonuses.History: Ming China maintained extensive overland and maritime trade networks stretching from Korea to East Africa.
TeamBonuses.Description: Allied markets and docks generate +10% trade income.

Structures.Name: Treasure Shipyard
Structures.History: Massive shipyards in Nanjing and elsewhere that built the world's largest wooden vessels.
Structures.Special: Unlocks heavy warships and reduces naval unit training time.

Structures.Name: Firearms Arsenal
Structures.History: Imperial workshops producing fire lances, hand cannons, rockets, and early matchlocks.
Structures.Special: Unlocks gunpowder units and advanced siege weapons.
